test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six friends are sitting in a circle facing the centre. They are P, Q, R, S, T and U. P is the immediate neighbour of T and S. S is sitting to the immediate left of Q. U is sitting to the immediate right of Q. R is the immediate neighbour of U and T. Who is sitting to the immediate right of T?
solution: The sitting arrangement as per the given information is as: 1. S is sitting to the immediate left of Q and U is sitting to the immediate right of Q.
